title: Nexus Infrastructure & Recurring Cost
notice: Internal administrative view. Never publish billing data on a public site.

connection.billing_detail: token has no billing scope (HTTP 403) — cost figures are human-confirmed

removed_zones.status: removed — not owned — added by mistake
removed_zones.note: Cloudflare zone removed; outside domain registration unaffected. A stale Cloudflare 'recent item' may linger in Cloudflare's own UI — that is history, not an active zone. Retained here for audit only and must not appear in active managed-domain counts.

workers.note: Workers stays Free by decision D-021. Do not record the $5 Workers Paid subscription until a later approved decision. Pages Functions, Workers and KV remain a capacity item to monitor, not a cost line.

items.note: Committed base subscription cost, not a guaranteed all-in ceiling. Applies to the Resonant zone only and is separate from Workers billing.

excluded_by_decision: Business, Enterprise, Argo, Log Explorer, R2, Load Balancing, Stream

deferred_projects.account_plan: Separate billable account planned when ready
deferred_projects.note: Not changed during the 2026-07-24 Cloudflare work and no plan was purchased. Mockup continues in the current local/Codex workflow.

infrastructure_risks: Workers and KV remain on Free — monitor request and write limits.
Client properties should move toward clearly separated ownership and billing as they become billable.
Cloudflare plan and payment status must be sourced from verified account data, never inferred from a website being up.
Optional Cloudflare products (Argo, Log Explorer, R2, Load Balancing, Stream, Business, Enterprise) require explicit human approval before activation.

analytics_policy.rule: Never hardcode a one-time Cloudflare traffic snapshot as live data. Any traffic metric must carry its source and a last-refreshed timestamp, and distinguish zone traffic, Worker invocations, KV operations and Pages builds. Missing API access reads 'not connected', never zero.
